policy.transform_requirement: Recorded /tf or /tf_static with actual valid sensor-to-pose chain, OR explicitly bound external commanded-pose/extrinsic convention in the future run spec
policy.conditional_transform_check: After generic inventory audit call integration.structural_recording_requirements.recording_readiness; then independently verify actual frames, transforms and organized input layout
policy.zero_advice_note: A legitimate timeout/fallback episode may have zero advice; preserve the episode but report full advice-exchange replay unavailable, not original baseline invalid

applicability.scene_scope: Future explicitly scoped tunnel development recordings only; not test-world authorization
applicability.method_registry: Legacy recorder loader compatibility only; methods list is not experiment authorization or bridge mode
applicability.bridge_mode: Additional evidence profile for full structural native-route replay, not the original disabled baseline validity
